language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the wooden spoon beside the yellow plate, closes around its handle at frames 105–110, and lifts it clear of the table by frames 133–140 (left_ego_image, wrist_image). It carries the spoon to the open drawer at frames 181–214, releases it at frames 224–227, and withdraws empty; the spoon remains inside the drawer at frames 228–250 (image, wrist_image). No failed acquisition, unintended object displacement, or other side effect is visibly established.
